summary: Read and reply to letters from Hermes.
page_description: A calm, letter-style inbox for thoughtful messages you can read anywhere.
release_notes: Paginated inbox, letter paging, durable drafts, and a reply outbox with queued, sending, delivered and rejected states; retries carry an idempotency key so a repeated send can never deliver twice.

steps.text: Deploy a compatible Hermes gateway behind HTTPS and note its public URL.
Install the gateway bearer token under the exact name hermes-post.
